executeSwap(bytes,address[],uint256[]).notice: Executes exactly one Aqua swap calldata reviewed and signed by the delegate. The immutable `app` is the only target, the sell approval is exact and cleared after the call, and all measured output is transferred directly to the Ledger owner.

returnToOwner(address[]).notice: Returns listed token balances to the immutable Ledger owner. The factory is the only caller, so an agent-signed action cannot choose a different recipient.
